title: SRD_Combat Sprite Asset Specification
description: Fully-prescribed generation spec for one entity's sprite set. References the entity index for base data; all ramp assignments are explicit.

entity_slug.description: Filename slug. For monsters: full name lowercased with underscores. For players: {class}_{species}_{variant}.

entity_type.description: Whether this is a monster or player character template.

dnd_size.description: D&D size category (Tiny, Small, Medium, Large, Huge, Gargantuan).

creature_type.description: D&D creature type from the entity index (e.g. 'Undead', 'Dragon (Chromatic)').

cr.description: Challenge rating from the entity index.

outline_family.description: Ramp family for the 1px exterior contour. One of: OUTLINE-WARM, OUTLINE-COOL, OUTLINE-VIOLET.

material_assignments.description: Map of semantic material name to ramp family. Every visible material region must have an entry. Keys are lowercase identifiers (body, armor, weapon, clothing, accent, eyes, wings, etc.).

additionalProperties.description: Ramp family name from the approved list in the sprite profiles.

pose_hint.description: Brief pose/action description for the AI generator.

material_overrides.description: Per-frame overrides to material_assignments (e.g. death frame might add BLOOD).

visual_descriptors.description: Visual keywords from the entity index, passed through to AI prompt.

generation_notes.description: Free-text notes for the AI generator about this specific entity.

player_species.description: For player specs only: which species variant this spec is for.

player_variant.description: For player specs only: visual variant tag (e.g. 'a', 'b', 'f', 'm').
